security_audit.summary: The only confirmed issue is the ShadCN setup block, which asks users or agents to run pnpm dlx shadcn@latest. The remaining backtick findings are Markdown fences or TypeScript template literals, with no prompt injection, data exfiltration, or obfuscated behavior found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned remote CLI execution in setup instructions
remediation.suggestion: Pin the ShadCN CLI version where possible and state that users must approve commands before execution.

remediation.issue: Shell setup commands are mixed with passive component examples
remediation.suggestion: Separate runnable setup commands from reference-only snippets so agents can avoid executing examples unexpectedly.

content.value_statement: Teams lose time wiring UI components and animations from scratch. This skill provides ShadCN UI and Framer Motion patterns for React interfaces.
actual_capabilities: Shows ShadCN CLI setup commands for init and adding button, card, and dialog components.
Provides a typed UserCard example using Card and Button components.
Demonstrates Framer Motion fade-in wrappers for client-side React usage.
Includes animated list, page transition, dialog, hover card, and skeleton examples.
Uses AnimatePresence and motion variants for common enter, exit, and hover states.
limitations: Does not include complete app wiring, routing, or package installation validation.
Assumes React, TypeScript, and an existing ShadCN-compatible project.
Examples use unpinned CLI commands and should not be run without review.
Does not cover accessibility testing or performance profiling for animations.

use_cases.title: Add Animated UI Components
use_cases.description: Create cards, dialogs, lists, transitions, and loading states with ShadCN UI and Framer Motion patterns.

use_cases.title: Prototype Interaction States

use_cases.title: Standardize React Motion Patterns

prompt_templates.title: Create A Basic Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the shadcn-framer skill to create a profile card with ShadCN Card and Button components. Keep the structure simple and typed.

prompt_templates.title: Add Fade-In Motion
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the shadcn-framer skill to add a reusable fade-in animation to an existing React section. Explain any client component requirement.

prompt_templates.title: Animate Dynamic Lists
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the shadcn-framer skill to design an animated task list with enter and exit transitions. Include stable item keys and motion variants.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Dialog And Page Transitions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the shadcn-framer skill to plan consistent motion for dialogs, hover cards, page transitions, and loading skeletons in a Next.js app.

output_examples.input: Create an animated profile card for a React dashboard.
output_examples.output: The skill guides a ShadCN Card layout, adds a Button action, and recommends a small Framer Motion entrance effect.

output_examples.input: Improve a modal with smoother open and close behavior.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests AnimatePresence, a scale and opacity transition, and a DialogContent composition that keeps ShadCN behavior intact.

output_examples.input: Add a loading placeholder for a data panel.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a reusable skeleton element with a subtle repeating opacity pulse and caller-provided class names.

best_practices: Review all setup commands before running them, especially commands that download packages.
Use small motion durations for interface feedback and avoid distracting transitions.
Keep ShadCN behavior and accessibility intact when wrapping components with motion elements.
anti_patterns: Do not run pnpm dlx commands automatically without user approval.
Do not animate every element on a page just because Framer Motion is available.
Do not replace ShadCN component semantics with decorative wrappers that break focus or keyboard behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build React UI components that combine ShadCN UI structure with Framer Motion animations.

faq.question: Does it install ShadCN automatically?
faq.answer: No. It shows setup commands, but users should review and approve commands before running them.

faq.question: Which projects fit this skill best?
faq.answer: It fits TypeScript React and Next.js projects that already use, or plan to use, ShadCN UI.

faq.question: Does it provide complete production components?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and examples. Users still need to adapt styling, data, accessibility, and project structure.

faq.question: Can it help with page transitions?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a page transition pattern using Framer Motion enter and exit states.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
